title: Add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v89
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: improve profiling baselines for the benchmark lab to cover recent model variants (fp16/4-bit quant), add representative workload runners for multi-variant scenarios, and extend the reporting pipeline to ingest adaptive-batching metrics. This change bundles three related pieces: 1) baseline profiling harness updates, 2) new representative workload runners for mixed latency/throughput workloads, and 3) reporting pipeline changes to publish per-variant metrics and quantization columnar data.

What changed: updated profiling harness to run on latest runner image, added mixed-workload YAMLs and runner scripts, added a reporting pipeline transform to normalize batch-size/kv-cache dimensions, and bumped the benchmark-lab DAG to v89.

Checklist:
- [x] Add profiling baseline jobs and configs
- [x] Add representative workload runners for multi-variant runs
- [x] Extend reporting pipeline transforms + storage schema migration
- [x] Add unit tests for transforms and small e2e smoke test
- [x] Update docs with runbook and dashboard links

Testing and rollout: locally validated profiling harness on dev cluster (cpu+gpu nodes), ran representative runners against small model variants and validated metrics in staging reporting pipeline. Reporting pipeline schema change is additive (new columns) and backward compatible. Plan is to monitor staging dashboards for 48h and then promote to prod.

Related tickets: ENG-7854, ENG-7921, PM-218 (feature prioritization).
